common.tagline: The city never sleeps. Neither do you.

city.title: The City
city.subtitle: Everyone can be found. Everyone has a price.
city.protectionDesc: Bodyguards ({price} OMD, 24 hours): doubles the bullets needed to take you down.
city.bountyPlaced: Bounty of {amount} OMD placed on {target}. The city knows.
city.noWanted: Nobody has a price on their head. Yet.
city.breakoutSuccess: {username} is free — the night swallowed you both.
city.breakoutFailed: Caught! The cops throw YOU in a cell.
city.jailedBanner: You're in jail — {time} left. The crooked cop looks away for a price.
city.noNews: A quiet night in the city.
city.killBody: Blood money: {blood} OMD · Bounty: {bounty} OMD · +{xp} XP

errors.target_not_found: Nobody in this town goes by that name.
errors.cannot_target_self: Whack yourself? The doctor is two blocks down.
errors.jailed: You can't act from a cell.
errors.chain_error: Blockchain transaction failed; your money was restored.

death.title: MURDERED
death.body: Your body floated down the river. But in this town, death is rarely the end…
death.witnessDesc: A new identity for {cost} OMD: keep {pct}% of your experience and your heat disappears. Open bounties on your old name expire.
death.witnessUnaffordable: Your estate is too thin for witness protection.
death.freshDesc: Same name, no experience. The streets forget quickly.

auth.noAccount: No name in the underworld yet?
auth.walletNote: Registration automatically creates a wallet for you on the Sonic blockchain.

errors.username_taken: That name is already taken in this town.
errors.invalid_input: Check your input: alias 3-20 characters, password at least 8.

crimes.title: Crimes
crimes.subtitle: Pick your job. The streets remember everything.
crimes.cooldownActive: Ease off for a moment — the cops are watching.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocketing
pickpocket.desc: A busy market, a careless tourist.

rob_drunk.name: Rob a drunk
rob_drunk.desc: He's lost count of his money anyway.

burgle_house.name: Burgle a house
burgle_house.desc: Somewhere a back door is always open.

steal_car.name: Steal a car
steal_car.desc: Gone before the owner can whistle.

extort_shop.name: Extort a shop
extort_shop.desc: Nice little place. Shame if something happened to it.

hijack_truck.name: Hijack a truck
hijack_truck.desc: A load of liquor vanishes into the night.

rob_bank.name: Rob the bank
rob_bank.desc: The big score. All or nothing.

bank.title: The Bank
bank.subtitle: Where dirty money turns clean and OMD leaves town.
bank.launderDesc: Turn dirty cash into clean cash. The laundromat charges {fee}% — and your heat drops.
bank.launderSuccess: {clean} OMD clean credited ({fee} OMD fee burned), heat -{heat}.
bank.withdrawDesc: Mint clean cash as OMD tokens to your wallet on Sonic.
bank.depositDesc: Burn OMD tokens from your wallet and receive game cash.
bank.chainDisabled: The blockchain link is disabled in this environment. Laundering still works; withdrawing and depositing require an active chain.

errors.insufficient_onchain_balance: Not enough OMD in your wallet.
errors.chain_error: The blockchain transaction failed. Your balance was restored.

profile.title: Profile
profile.maxRank: It doesn't get higher than this, Godfather.
profile.heatDesc: The higher your heat, the more jobs fail. Laundering cools you down.
